# ORPEM

> ORPEM is a Brussels-based EU communications and public affairs consultancy — a consortium of companies, NGOs, and independent consultants — that helps NGOs, associations, lobby groups, and startups build their voice and make it heard where decisions are made in the European Union.

## Services

- [Brand & Digital Presence](https://orpem.eu/#services): Brand strategy, positioning and naming; visual identity systems and guidelines; website design and development; reports, position papers, and pitch decks for audiences including MEPs, commissioners, and investors.
- [Strategic Communications](https://orpem.eu/#services): EU stakeholder communications strategy; media relations and press engagement; social media management and campaigns; position papers, op-eds, and thought leadership.
- [Network & Access](https://orpem.eu/#services): Introductions to the European Commission, European Parliament, and EU agencies; partner and coalition matching; EU funding bid co-applicant sourcing; impact investor and philanthropic access.

## Selected Work

- [Flemish Club Brussels NGO](https://orpem.eu/#work): Brand redesign and full website overhaul, plus a proprietary event management system built to let the organisation plan, organise, and run its own events from a single platform.
- [Salon Liberté](https://orpem.eu/#work): After its previous sponsor withdrew support amid a political shift in its home country, ORPEM connected the organisation with a new investor and guided an organisational pivot to secure long-term stability.
- [EU Jobs Co.](https://orpem.eu/#work): Full rebrand plus a LinkedIn growth strategy that grew the company's LinkedIn following to over 2,000 and generated roughly 80% of all company leads, contributing to the company securing venture capital investment in San Francisco.
- [KULBRUXMUN](https://orpem.eu/#work): Brand overhaul and Instagram-led marketing strategy for the KU Leuven Brussels Model United Nations programme, plus stakeholder negotiation with STUVO's junior enterprise fund that secured a reclassification of operations and a significant subsidy increase.

## About

- [About ORPEM](https://orpem.eu/#about): A consortium of companies, NGOs, and independent consultants with collective expertise in corporate branding, EU advocacy, government relations across Belgium, Indonesia, and Slovakia, and the EU political startup ecosystem. Based in Brussels, serving the European Union.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://orpem.eu/#contact): Email info@orpem.eu, or book a meeting via Google Calendar. Located in Brussels, Belgium.
